title: Chapter 330 Provocation
content:
Chapter 330 Provocation

The test of the illusion will soon end. After all, dreaming is a long time in the dream, but the real time is actually very short.

In about half an hour, everyone in the arena had completely withdrawn from the illusion, and looked at each other in blank dismay, obviously not knowing whether they had passed the test or not.

But with the lesson just now, although everyone was extremely worried, they didn't speak.

"Very good, many of you meet my conditions and have the aptitude to practice my sword sect."

A smile finally appeared on Zhong Yu's face, although the students below were far away from his place, more than 30 meters away.

But they still clearly saw the smile on his face and felt his joy.

This kind of miraculous place can't help but make these students even more awed.

"However, although some people have passed my test, there are also some people who have failed. For these people, I can only ask you to consider whether to continue to stay and listen. It is better to leave now and not waste time."

Zhong Yu changed the subject, his tone became serious, he stared sharply at the many anxious people below, and asked them mercilessly.

"My lord, may I ask who among us failed to pass? Your formation is too amazing, and it's hard for me to guess!"

A young man who was dressed luxuriously and had a dignified face asked below.

It seems that this young man's background should be quite extraordinary, at least he is also a direct descendant of a wealthy family, and he will be able to take over a figure from a wealthy family in the future.

Otherwise, there is absolutely no courage to ask. It must be the confidence in one's own identity that has the courage to speak out.

Zhong Yu didn't say anything when he heard the words, he pinched the seal formula in his hand, and saw a flash of blood, and there were little blood lights in the formation.

These bloody lights danced and hovered in the air, constantly swimming, and finally, under Zhong Yu's command, quickly enveloped all the people who passed by.

"Those who are shrouded in blood will be those who pass, and will be admitted as inner disciples by me. The rest are unqualified, and you can decide whether to stay or not."

Seeing that the blood glow had completely dissipated, turning into blood and covering the students, he finally spoke.

As for the more than 700 students below, only 56 of them were actually shrouded in blood. Compared to the huge number of people, it is really rare and indescribable.

Suddenly, many people below couldn't control their emotions and burst into tears.

"No, it's impossible. I have outstanding aptitude, and the noble blood of the Yamaguchi family flows through my body. How could I be surpassed by these untouchables? You must have made a mistake in the test!"

The young man below who had just been confident of his identity when he asked was flustered and grim, his mouth full of disbelief.

Seeing the boy's performance, the people around sneered a few times, full of pleasure and disdain.

Just relying on his own status, this young man is quite insulting to those around him, especially those who were born poor and humble.

Out of fear of being a teenager, these people dared not speak out, so they could only endure it. Seeing the boy make a fool of himself now, why would he feel sad for him. There were uncontrollable smiles on all the faces, and the eyes were full of teasing.

"You, it's you, you must be resentful that I just asked about it, so you deliberately brushed me off. I am the direct descendant of the Yamaguchi family. If you torture me like this, my Yamaguchi family will never let go of this tone. "

As soon as the boy's words were spoken, the expressions of many people around him changed.

Some of them were out of fear, some out of hatred, some out of secret joy, and some out of disdain.

The Yamaguchi family is second only to the daimyo Yamamoto family in the entire Yamamoto County.

The entire family has an army of 700 people, and these 60 warriors, the strength of the entire Yamamoto County can be said to be superior to all families, except for the Yamamoto family.

Therefore, relying on his own status, this young man can be said to be domineering and domineering in the entire Yamamoto County without any scruples.

Over time, he developed a domineering and domineering personality.

The reason why he came to this dojo to learn the magic method this time is only because of the strict order of his father, the Yamaguchi family.

In the heart of the young man, he was extremely disdainful of this so-called exiled nobleman.

It's just a loser who failed in the political struggle, even if he has a noble blood, he's just a lost dog.

And no matter how high his force is, can he still beat the 60 warriors and 700 troops of Sankou's family!

So when this boy first came, he was extremely displeased with Zhong Yu's performance of standing at the highest place and looking down on them, and there was resentment in his heart.

Then there was a few words of sarcasm that were not itchy or painful just now, and this was the reason for him to vent.

Now this young man was left behind by a large number of untouchables, and he, a dignified nobleman, was finally dismissed. He couldn't help but feel very humiliated, and couldn't bear it for a while.

So, the young man forgot that his father gave him thousands of instructions when he came here, be careful in doing things, he must put away his domineering personality, and he should not give any disrespectful advice to Zhong Yu.

He opened his mouth to insult Zhong Yu.

What kind of person is Zhong Yu? The emperor who once controlled the lives of tens of millions of people is now approaching the status of the emperor of heaven, and he has touched the powerhouse in the demigod realm.

Even if he is seriously injured now, it feels a bit like a tiger falling into the sky, but his own dignity cannot be insulted, and he is extremely proud of himself.

And how could he endure the insult of a little landlord's son in this area.

So Zhong Yu moved.

With a swipe of Zhong Yu's fingertip, a bloody silk thread suddenly appeared in front of the boy in the square.

The silk thread seemed to be floating slowly in the air, but in fact it was flying very fast. It wrapped around the young man's body in an instant, binding him so that he couldn't move.

Then bursts of blood erupted from the silk thread, under the influence of the blood light, the young man creaked all over his body, and wailed mournfully.

Not long after that, the boy withered away at a speed visible to the naked eye, and the whole person quickly entered the middle age of a teenager.

In the end, it turned into a dry bone, completely fell to the ground, and then was blown by the wind, turned into fly ash.

The people in the square couldn't help but gasped. Such a living person was sucked into a mummified corpse by such a cruel method. In the end, there was no bones left.

What scares them even more is that the master of this dojo killed the young master of the Yamaguchi family. With the strength of the Yamaguchi family, will they really swallow this breath?

But regarding their worries, Zhong Yu had nothing to fear.

Although the strength of the Yamaguchi family is strong, there are only three third-tier masters among them.

And Zhong Yu himself is the third rank, and it can be said that it is easy to deal with ordinary masters in this third rank.

Therefore, the masters of the Yamaguchi family could not pose any threat to Zhong Yu at all.

But if the Yamaguchi family wanted to wipe out Zhong Yu, they could only mobilize a large army to besiege.

But Zhong Yu is not blind, wouldn't he allow the wounds to mobilize an army to encircle and suppress him? Will he not run?

Therefore, the Yamaguchi family did not pose any threat to Zhong Yu at all.

Not to mention, Zhong Yu performed a profound and unpredictable yin and yang technique today, and the people of the Yamaguchi family would definitely think about his background.

Being able to cultivate a power of Zhong Yu's level must be extremely terrifying, and it is far from something that a small local tyrant like the Yamaguchi family can afford.

So not only will the Yamaguchi family not come to blame, but I am afraid they will come to make amends soon.

For Zhong Yu's horror, the entire Yamamoto County's tyrants have a recognition that they are mysterious and powerful, and they are not something small local tyrants like them can provoke.

This is also the reason why the head of the Yamaguchi family asked thousands of times not to cause trouble before sending his son here.

But he didn't think that his son was just a piece of mud that couldn't support the wall, and the glass heart couldn't bear a little blow, and he ended up dying in the end, and it was his own fault.
